tools.name: pet_house
tools.description: Operate your own house DIRECTLY with this tool, never by moving/clicking the computer mouse. enter walks to the door then enters; exit walks out. eat sits on the dining chair; phone/sofa uses the ORIGINAL whale Bilibili program and gives you actual video content; bed sleeps; chair sits; lamp toggles; window looks outside; record toggles the attached local song; fridge opens; store/withdraw stands on the whale stool and transfers rice; board opens notes; note writes a HUMAN-requested todo. state reads real residence, inventory and history. Collapsed rooms stay collapsed and replies show over their door. Wait for actual receipts, never invent completion. Sleeping pets need a human wake-up.

op.description: For note: add, edit or erase a HUMAN-requested todo after walking to the board.

dailyAt.description: Daily HH:mm, Asia/Shanghai; empty clears schedule.

tools.name: pet_say
tools.description: Say something in a speech bubble above the pet. Expressions and motions go into the script as markers: 【…】 plays them first and then starts a new bubble; <…> plays them when the typing reaches that point. The receipt says roughly how long it stays on screen; a non-empty script fails when the pet window is not connected.

script.description: What to say, with optional 【expression, motion】 and <expression> markers. One or two sentences per bubble. May be empty when images carry the message. Do not call this when you have nothing to say.

images.description: Images to show the person with this line, each given by the handle that starts a [blob …] line in your context. They appear on the chat page only, not in the bubble.

summary.zh: 在桌宠头顶的气泡里说话,可在话里穿插表情与动作。
summary.en: Speaks in a bubble above the pet, with expressions and motions in between.

tools.name: pet_ask
tools.description: Show a question bubble with up to 3 options under it, plus by default a box for the person to write their own answer. Returns at once; the answer arrives later as an event, and so does closing the question unanswered. A new pet_say or pet_ask replaces a question not yet answered.

options.description: 1–3 short options, at most 40 characters each; longer ones are cut.

allowOwnAnswer.description: Offer a box for writing an own answer; default true.

summary.zh: 弹出带至多 3 个选项的提问气泡,回答之后作为事件送回。
summary.en: Asks a question in a bubble with up to 3 options; the answer comes back later as an event.

tools.name: pet_move_to
tools.description: Go somewhere on the screen the pet is on: walk (or run) along its bottom edge to a position, or go to one of the targets the current figure has of its own, which the environment section lists when it has any. Returns on arrival or interruption, after 30 seconds at most.

to.description: Target: a number from 0 to 1 (a fraction of the width of the screen the pet is on, 0 leftmost, 1 rightmost), left / center / right / cursor (the horizontal position of the mouse pointer), or the id of one of the current figure's own targets.

run.description: true to run; walks by default.

params.description: Only for a figure's own target that takes numbers: them, in the order the environment section lists them.

summary.zh: 沿屏幕底边走到或跑到某个位置,或去形象包自带的目标。
summary.en: Walks or runs along the bottom edge of the screen to a position, or goes to one of the figure pack's own targets.

tools.name: pet_set
tools.description: Change your own looks and habits. Depending on the person's settings, some items take effect at once and others are first asked of the person in a bubble, changing only if they agree, with the receipt coming after their answer; the environment section says which items are which, and the values to choose from. Give only the items to change.

figure.description: Figure: coo, or the id of an installed figure. Switching to a figure pack without a scheme puts on its first one.

scheme.description: The dress of the current figure (or of the one being switched to): a preset id, or one option per axis joined with - in axis order (for Coo: palette-head-side-glasses-neck).

roam.description: Walking about: free walks often, calm mostly stays put, off does not wander.

snoreSeconds.description: Seconds of snoring each time you fall asleep; 0 snores until you wake.

scale.description: Size on screen, 1 being the default.

bubbleSize.description: Width, padding, corners and tail of the speech bubbles (yours and the person's), 1 being the default; the text keeps its size.

fontSize.description: Size of the text in the speech bubbles, 1 being the default; the bubbles keep their width.

theme.description: dark is night (light body), light is day (dark body).

hoverButtons.description: The buttons beside you while the mouse pointer rests on you.

user.description: What you call the person, at most 20 characters.

summary.zh: 修改桌宠自己的外观与习惯;按使用者的设置直接生效,或先在气泡里询问。
summary.en: Changes the pet's own looks and habits, at once or after asking in a bubble, as the person's settings say.

tools.name: pet_quiet
tools.description: Keep quiet for a while: by default sound effects off and standing still, restored when the time is up; the settings stay as they are. If the person changes sound or walking themselves meanwhile, their choice holds and the quiet ends early. minutes 0 ends it now.

sound.description: Sound effects during the quiet; default false.

roam.description: Walking during the quiet; default off.

summary.zh: 安静一段时间:关掉音效、停止走动,到时恢复。
summary.en: Keeps quiet for a while: sound effects off and standing still until the time is up.

tools.name: pet_act
tools.description: Play a sequence of expressions or motions without speaking (the current figure's vocabulary is in the environment section). Returns at once; words marked as held until the next action stay on.

actions.description: Expression or motion words, played in order.

summary.zh: 不说话,播放一串表情或动作。
summary.en: Plays a sequence of expressions or motions without speaking.

tools.name: pet_cua_open_settings
tools.description: Computer use is off. Open the settings window at its switch, where the person reads what turning it on risks and can turn it on. Only after the person has agreed to open it.

summary.zh: 电脑操作关着时,把设置窗口打开到它的开关,附风险说明。
summary.en: While computer use is off, opens the settings window at its switch, with what it risks.

tools.name: pet_cua_screenshot
tools.description: Capture one display. Returns the scaled image (with the mouse pointer drawn on it), its size and the display's, the other displays, the pointer position and the title of the foreground window. Later coordinates are pixels of this screenshot.

display.description: Display number, 1 = leftmost; omitted: the display looked at last, at first the one holding the foreground window

summary.zh: 截取一块显示器,附鼠标位置与前台窗口标题。
summary.en: Captures one display, with the pointer position and the foreground window title.

tools.name: pet_cua_zoom
tools.description: Capture a region of the latest screenshot's display again at full resolution, for small text or icons the scaled screenshot blurs. The region is given in screenshot pixels; the zoomed image is for reading only.

x.description: Horizontal position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

y.description: Vertical position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

summary.zh: 按原始分辨率重截截图里的一块,读看不清的小字。
summary.en: Captures a region of the screenshot again at full resolution, for small text.

tools.name: pet_cua_click
tools.description: Move the mouse to (x, y) and click.

x.description: Horizontal position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

y.description: Vertical position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

clicks.description: 1 single click (default), 2 double click, 3 triple click

screenshot.description: Attach a screenshot afterwards; defaults to the configuration (attach). Leave it out only for a step whose result you do not need to see; after a step that may open a window or dialog, look before typing.

summary.zh: 把鼠标移到某处并点击。
summary.en: Moves the mouse to a point and clicks.

tools.name: pet_cua_move
tools.description: Only move the mouse to (x, y), without clicking; for hovering to bring up a tooltip or a menu.

x.description: Horizontal position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

y.description: Vertical position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

screenshot.description: Attach a screenshot afterwards; defaults to the configuration (attach). Leave it out only for a step whose result you do not need to see; after a step that may open a window or dialog, look before typing.

tools.name: pet_cua_drag
tools.description: Hold the left button down, drag from `from` to `to`, and release. Both points are on the display of the latest screenshot.

screenshot.description: Attach a screenshot afterwards; defaults to the configuration (attach). Leave it out only for a step whose result you do not need to see; after a step that may open a window or dialog, look before typing.

summary.zh: 按住左键从一处拖到另一处。
summary.en: Drags with the left button from one point to another.

tools.name: pet_cua_scroll
tools.description: Move the mouse to (x, y) and turn the wheel. Positive down scrolls down, negative up; positive right scrolls right. Units are wheel notches.

x.description: Horizontal position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

y.description: Vertical position, in pixels of the latest screenshot

screenshot.description: Attach a screenshot afterwards; defaults to the configuration (attach). Leave it out only for a step whose result you do not need to see; after a step that may open a window or dialog, look before typing.

summary.en: Turns the mouse wheel at a point.

tools.name: pet_cua_type
tools.description: Type text at the current input focus (any language, whatever state the input method is in); \n presses Enter once. Click where the text goes first.

screenshot.description: Attach a screenshot afterwards; defaults to the configuration (attach). Leave it out only for a step whose result you do not need to see; after a step that may open a window or dialog, look before typing.

summary.zh: 在当前输入焦点输入文字。
summary.en: Types text at the current input focus.

tools.name: pet_cua_key
tools.description: Press a key or a key combination. Join keys pressed together with +, and separate keys pressed one after another with spaces: "ctrl+s", "alt+f4", "ctrl+a delete", "enter", "win".

screenshot.description: Attach a screenshot afterwards; defaults to the configuration (attach). Leave it out only for a step whose result you do not need to see; after a step that may open a window or dialog, look before typing.

summary.en: Presses a key or a key combination.

tools.name: pet_cua_windows
tools.description: List the visible top-level windows: title, which display each is on (with its position in screenshot coordinates when that is the display of the latest screenshot), whether minimized, and which one is in the foreground.

tools.name: pet_cua_focus
tools.description: Bring a window to the foreground (restoring it first if minimized). window is a handle from pet_cua_windows, or part of its title.

screenshot.description: Attach a screenshot afterwards; defaults to the configuration (attach). Leave it out only for a step whose result you do not need to see; after a step that may open a window or dialog, look before typing.

summary.en: Brings a window to the foreground.

tools.name: pet_cua_wait
tools.description: Wait a number of seconds (30 at most) for the screen to load, then take a screenshot. Waiting needs no permission from the person; while looking at the screen is not yet allowed this turn, it waits without a screenshot.

summary.en: Waits a few seconds, then takes a screenshot.

tools.name: feiyu_house_state
tools.description: Read the real Feiyu house, remaining rice, energy, todo schedules and execution results. Use pet_house for actions: it walks to furniture before acting. Never invent successful execution.

description.zh: 使用者在气泡里或对话页上打了字,对话页上的可带图片。
description.en: The person typed a message in the bubble or on the chat page; one from the chat page may carry images.

description.zh: 使用者按住说话键说的话,识别成的文字。
description.en: What the person said while holding the talk key, as recognized text.

description.zh: pet_ask 问题的回答,或问题没有回答就被关掉。
description.en: The answer to a pet_ask question, or the question closed unanswered.

description.zh: 使用者戳、摸、扔出或拎起放下了桌宠。
description.en: The person poked, patted, threw or dropped the pet.

description.zh: 使用者换了形象或装扮,或形象没能加载。
description.en: The person switched the figure or its dress, or a figure failed to load.

description.zh: 白饭机制：一碗饭落到脚边、吃完、收进口袋，或从口袋拿出来吃。
description.en: The rice mechanic: a bowl landed, was eaten, was stored in the pocket, or was taken out of the pocket.

description.zh: 桌宠自己说的话与做的事,只给对话页显示,不送给 bot。
description.en: What the pet said and did, kept for the chat page and never delivered to the bot.

changelog.0.1.0-beta.3:
- 自动刷B站改为精力严格低于40且一小时未被玩家主动唤醒；白饭能量不参与这个门槛。
- 记录玩家主动唤醒时间并跨重启保留；后台台词与自动行动不重置计时。恢复沙发和自动续看也检查条件，手动刷视频保留。
- 服务端复查自动刷视频条件，同步行动指南与生活说明；旧的可调沙发精力门槛不再覆盖新规则。
- 包含beta.2的进屋状态同步、鼠标松开恢复、过门中断收尾与普通重启保留小屋接管修复。
changelog.0.1.0-beta.2:
- 普通World重启保留小屋接管；主动恢复原桌宠仍有效。
- 屋外展开、收起及时保存collapsed，与人物位置独立；启动恢复上次展开状态。
- 过门后立即保存屋内位置，取消与失败清理动画、走位和活动占用。
- 鼠标松开事件丢失后，可通过无按键移动恢复；正常拖拽保持。
- 进屋失败返回实际原因和识别码，便于继续定位。
- 直接停用/卸载前需先主动恢复原桌宠，见README。
changelog.0.1.0-beta.1:
- 以“肥鱼的小日子”和新安装包名首次发布，基于小屋生活beta.5；住宅World与存档保持兼容，旧测试包需要先移除，禁止同时启用。
- 保留音乐成功接口、共享语音模型、首次屋外与重启位置、双满出屋和空闲回沙发、选片来源与已看去重等修复。
- 保留蓝门头像和发布者指定默认歌曲，增加原作者与素材逐项署名、刷B站工具MIT许可和来源。
- 实验性版本，原版入口、托盘与第三方兼容边界见README；不声称原生麦克风与扬声器已验收。
changelog.0.12.0-beta.5:
- 修复唱片机成功接口被误判为失败，复用原版已下载的语音模型目录。
- 仅首次安装默认在屋外；重启保留位置和睡眠。取消屋中央热点标记。
- 饭量与精力均满时出屋，长时间无互动回沙发；屋外对话重置空闲计时。
- 热门选片不再混入预设偏好搜索，移除作者默认喜好并保存已看记录；个人配置保留。
changelog.0.12.0-beta.4:
- 调低并加长记事板线条，四排饭碗按左前、中后、右前排列，标注默认隐藏。
- 随包提供用户指定歌曲的AAC播放副本，World新增唱片机页面，可添加和选择本地歌曲。
- 保留动作失败的具体原因；活动节奏跟随实时回应与走动习惯。
- 接入用户确认的白饭与精力说明，每次重启与上下文组装重新读取，保留既有提示词覆盖。
changelog.0.12.0-beta.3:
- 项目展示名称改为“大肥鱼·小屋生活”，同步面板、说明和市场简介。
- 使用参考现有蓝色房门重绘的方形头像，生成适合市场加载的 256×256 PNG。
- 本地手动试装版；内部包名、World 标识及存档位置保持兼容，不含个人数据。
changelog.0.12.0-beta.2:
- 修复公开包漏带白饭图片、饥饿条显示破图的问题。
- 加入图标、中英文市场简介、能力及风险标签，明确安装条件和兼容边界。
- 发布检查增加白饭图片的实际请求与PNG文件检查。
changelog.0.12.0-beta.1:
- 豪宅运行组件移到包内，切换通过Coopanion的World启停接口完成。
- 增加启用与恢复面板，保留原工具名和消息事件。
- 使用同一住宅状态，不分发作者快照与个人凭据。
- 保留0.11.4已确认的手机握姿及豪宅行为。
